routes.summary: List approval policies, paginated.
Get a single approval policy's full definition.
Create an approval policy (priority + docType + approval chain).
Update an approval policy.
Submit a PR/PO/SCO document for approval against its matching policy.
Get an approval request's details, joined with its policy name/description.
Get the full action trail (submit/approve/reject/...) for an approval request.
Act on the current approval level of a request (approve/reject/sent_back/withdraw). `notes` is required for approve/reject/sent_back (400 APPROVAL_NOTES_REQUIRED).
List approval requests currently pending on the caller (or, for super-admin, another employee).
Look up the currently open approval request for a given document, if any.
Approval history of a document (BR-APR-54): all its requests newest first, each with its trail oldest first. Readable per BR-APR-51.
List machines, paginated.
Create a machine.
Update a machine.
List item master rows, paginated.
Create an item master row.
Update an item master row.

Look up the rate to prefill for an item+supplier: the contract rate usable on onDate (default today IST; only for po.manage / contract.view holders), then newest approved-or-later PO line price, then supplier catalog price, then item average cost (> 0), then item standard rate. Returns the source.
List service master rows, paginated.
Create a service master row.
Update a service master row.
List inventory movement rows, paginated.
Manual stock movement: stock-take (stock_adjustment, counted qty) or opening stock (opening_stock, qty + rate) only, reason required. Document reference types get 400.
Stock view: per item unit, stock, average cost, value, per-location balances, reorder flag, inactive mark.
Stock reconciliation: items whose stock != ledger total and item+location pairs whose last balance != ledger total. Zero rows = OK.
List inventory locations, paginated.
Create an inventory location.
Update an inventory location.
Log in with email/password, returns access token + sets refresh cookie.
Operator QR login: scanned QR token, returns access token + sets refresh cookie.
Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token.
Clear the refresh cookie and revoke the refresh token.
Return the authenticated user's own profile.

List BOM revisions, paginated (BR-BOM-25). Filters: `status` (comma list; default active,draft, or all three when `partId` is given), `kind`, `q` (part SKU / name), `partId` (all revisions of one part).
Needs preview for a part and quantity, full tree or one level (BR-BOM-18). Reads no stock, writes nothing, no prices. 409 NO_ACTIVE_BOM when the part has no active revision.
Parts whose ACTIVE revision uses the item, as a line, the sent item or the alloy (BR-BOM-19, 16). Paginated.
Audit rows of a part's BOMs, newest first (BR-BOM-23). Paginated.
Start a new draft revision of a part: copy of the active revision, else the latest retired (BR-BOM-14). 409 BOM_DRAFT_OPEN when a draft exists.
One BOM revision: header, lines, computed casting figures, audit, `nextStep` (BR-BOM-05, 21, 23, 24).
Level tree under this revision: quantity per piece, `no_bom` / inactive tags; 400 BOM_TOO_LARGE above 1,000 nodes (BR-BOM-09, 10, 21).
Dry run of release: added / removed / changed lines and header old -> new vs the part's active revision, plus `problems[]` (BR-BOM-12, 13).
Create the first BOM of a part: draft revision A (BR-BOM-01..08, 10). 409 BOM_ALREADY_EXISTS when the part has a revision.
Replace a draft's header and lines; needs the `version` from the last read (BR-BOM-03..11). 409 BOM_NOT_DRAFT / BOM_CHANGED_SINCE_REVIEW.
Delete a draft BOM (BR-BOM-15). 409 BOM_NOT_DRAFT.
Release a draft: draft -> active, the previous active -> retired (BR-BOM-12, 13, 17). 400 BOM_RELEASE_INVALID lists every problem; 409 BOM_NOT_DRAFT / BOM_RELEASE_CONFLICT / BOM_CHANGED_SINCE_REVIEW.
Retire an active BOM with no replacement; reason 3-500 chars (BR-BOM-16). 409 BOM_NOT_ACTIVE.
Get our company details for the job-work challan (BR-SCO-09). `data` is null until saved.
Create or replace the single company-settings row (owner only, BR-SCO-09). All four fields required.
Company settings change history, one row per changed field, newest first (BR-SCO-29). Read-only.
Read the supplier-invoice match tolerances in percent (BR-SINV-32). Defaults 0% price, 0.5% weight until saved.
Set the price and/or weight tolerance in percent (0-10, 2 decimals, at least one). Applies to the next submit. 409 SINV_COMPANY_NOT_SET before company details are saved.
List customers, paginated (BR-SO-03). Filters `q` (name), `isActive`, `stateCode`; also the customer combobox (`?isActive=true&q=`).
One customer (BR-SO-03). 404 when missing.
Create a customer (BR-SO-01, 03). 400 bad GSTIN or GSTIN / state mismatch; 409 CUSTOMER_NAME_EXISTS.
Edit a customer, activate / deactivate with `isActive` (BR-SO-01, 02). At least one field. 409 CUSTOMER_NAME_EXISTS.
List GRNs, paginated. Filterable by poId/status/qaStatus.
Get a GRN with its line items, joined back to item master + PO-item ordered qty.
Record a goods receipt against a dispatched/partial_received PO. Created as draft — no stock effect until a line is QA-accepted or bypassed.
Update a draft GRN's header fields and/or line arrivedQty. Only legal while draft.
Delete a draft GRN. Only legal while draft.

QA decision on a GRN line: acceptedQty + rejectedQty = arrived. Accepted qty > 0 posts to the inventory ledger (referenceType=grn) and rolls the PO item/status forward. Past 105% of ordered qty: 400 unless the actor holds grn.over_receipt_override and sends overrideReason.
Fast-track QA bypass for a GRN line (mandatory reason). Posts to the inventory ledger immediately (referenceType=grn_bypass) and rolls the PO item/status forward.
Correct a previously posted GRN line: posts one grn_correction ledger row (-qty at the posted cost), lowers PO received qty; the line's acceptedQty is never edited.
List purchase orders, paginated. `overdue=true` (BR-PO-19) filters to dispatched/partial_received POs with open qty whose due date (revised date if set, else expected date) is before today.
Get a purchase order with its line items, joined back to the source PR lines for traceability.
Create a purchase order by drafting lines from pending PR items (full remaining PR-item quantity always used).
Update a draft purchase order's fields and/or insert/reprice/delete line items.

Cancel a purchase order (BR-PO-11): only draft/pending_approval/approved/dispatched with no GRN (else 409). `reason` (3-500 chars) is required for every status. Linked PR lines are cancelled and the open approval request is cancelled.
Mark a PO as sent to the supplier (approved -> dispatched) and log the communication.
Log a reminder sent to the supplier for an overdue PO.
Log an escalation action taken for an overdue PO.
Record a supplier-revised delivery date and delay reason. expectedDeliveryDate is never overwritten.
Record supplier confirmation of the PO. Informational only, never blocks a status transition.
Close a PO (legal from fully_received or invoiced) — terminal, no further transitions.
Short-close a partial_received PO as a whole (BR-PO-13): open qty dropped, PR lines closed, PO closed. Reason 3-500 chars.
PO log (sent / reminder / escalation rows: who, when, channel, note), newest first.
List purchase requisitions (PRs feed into purchase order creation), paginated.
Get a purchase requisition with its line items.
Create a purchase requisition with its line items.
Update a purchase requisition's fields and/or insert/update/delete line items.
Cancel a purchase requisition (soft cancel; reason 3-500 chars required).

Cancel one pending PR line (BR-PR-33): header must be approved/partial_ordered, requester or super-admin only. A line on a PO is 409 PR_LINE_ON_LIVE_PO; the header is recomputed (BR-PR-36, all lines cancelled -> PR cancelled). Reason 3-500 chars is required.
List purchase returns, paginated. Filter by status/supplierId/grnId/poId/dateFrom/dateTo/q. meta adds statusCounts and awaitingCount.
Awaiting-return GRN lines (rejected qty not yet reserved by a non-cancelled return), paginated. Filter by supplierId. meta adds statusCounts and awaitingCount.
Purchase return details: header, lines, document flow, debit note, events, draft post preview. Also feeds the debit note and return challan prints.
Suggested draft for Return to supplier from a GRN. Writes nothing.
Create a draft purchase return from one posted GRN. Rate, GST %, item, unit and heat no. are server-set (extra body key is 400).
Edit a draft return (id in body). lines, if sent, replace all lines.
Cancel a draft return. Empty body allowed.
Post a draft return: accepted lines leave stock (ledger pro), debit note and challan numbers are made, counters move. Empty body allowed.
Cancel a posted return with a reason: stock comes back (ledger pro_cancel), debit note cancelled, counters reversed.

List rate contracts, paginated (default createdAt desc; validTo asc with endsWithinDays). Filters status (draft|active|expired|terminated|cancelled, expired is computed), supplierId, itemId, endsWithinDays, q.
Contract details: header, status and effectiveStatus, lines with agreed / ordered / received qty, % ordered and cap, and the POs on the contract.
Create a draft rate contract (1-500 lines, each item once, active item and supplier).
Edit a draft contract (id in body, full replacement of header fields and lines). 409 CONTRACT_NOT_EDITABLE unless draft.

Activate a draft contract. 409 CONTRACT_OVERLAP (clashing contractNumber in details) when another active contract covers the same supplier, item and dates; 400 CONTRACT_DATES_INVALID when validTo is before today.
Terminate an active, not expired contract with a reason; terminatedOn defaults to today (IST) and must be today..validTo, else 400 CONTRACT_DATES_INVALID. 409 CONTRACT_INVALID_STATUS otherwise.
Cancel a draft contract with a reason. 409 CONTRACT_NOT_EDITABLE unless draft.
Live low-stock list, saves nothing (BR-RO-01..08, 21). Rows carry state will_be_ordered | covered | needs_reorder_qty | ok; meta.stateCounts ignore the state filter.
Run history, newest first (BR-RO-22). Filters `state` (comma list of running, done, failed) and `trigger`.
One run with its raised / skipped / deferred items, PR and PO link (BR-RO-22). 404 REORDER_RUN_NOT_FOUND.
Start a reorder run now (BR-RO-11..16). 201 returns the finished run: state done (pr null = nothing to order) or failed (failureReason). 409 REORDER_RUN_BUSY.
Reorder settings: switch, run hour (IST), draft owner, draftOwnerValid, last changed by (BR-RO-20).
Change switch / run hour / draft owner, one history row per changed field (BR-RO-20). draftOwnerId null clears. 400 REORDER_OWNER_INVALID.
Active employees holding pr.manage (super-admin included) for the draft owner select (BR-RO-20).
Pick list of pending PR lines (approved or partial_ordered PRs) for a new RFQ, with onOpenRfq / openRfqId / openRfqNumber. Filters prId, itemId, onOpenRfq, q.
List RFQs, paginated (default createdAt desc). Filters status, supplierId, from / to (created IST days), q (number, notes). Rows add supplierCount, quotedCount, lineCount.
RFQ details: header, suppliers, lines (award, PO number and status, PR-line-cancelled flag), quote headers. lineRates (last PO rate, contract rates) only for callers with po.manage or contract.view.
Create a draft RFQ from pending PR lines and 1-10 suppliers. Qty, uom and item are copied from the PR line, never sent.
Edit a draft RFQ (id in body, at least one other field): dueDate, notes, add / remove suppliers and PR lines. 409 RFQ_NOT_EDITABLE unless draft.
One supplier quote with its lines (computed value, tax, landed rate).
Edit a draft quote: replaces all its lines (no supplierId). 409 QUOTE_NOT_EDITABLE when submitted or cancelled.
Submit a draft quote (draft to submitted). Sets isLate when the submit day is after the RFQ due date. 400 QUOTE_EMPTY when no line is quoted.
Cancel a quote with a reason. A submitted quote on a sent RFQ also needs rfq.award (checked in the service, 403 PERMISSION_DENIED with key). 409 QUOTE_AWARDED when any line is awarded.
notes: Service-level key: rfq.award for a submitted quote after send.

routes.summary: Send a draft RFQ (draft to sent). 409 RFQ_LINE_STALE / SUPPLIER_INACTIVE_STALE name the id in details; 409 RFQ_INVALID_STATUS otherwise.
Cancel an RFQ with a reason. 409 RFQ_HAS_AWARD when a line is awarded; 409 RFQ_INVALID_STATUS when final.
Close an RFQ with a reason: open lines are dropped, draft quotes cancelled, submitted ones not_awarded. 409 RFQ_INVALID_STATUS when final.
Print data, one sheet per supplier with no rates and no other supplier. Allowed from sent onward; draft or cancelled gives 409 RFQ_INVALID_STATUS.
Enter a draft quote for a supplier on a sent / partially_awarded RFQ. One entry per RFQ line (missing = not quoted). No value, tax or landed field is accepted; they are computed.
Comparison grid computed on read: lines x suppliers with landed rate, lowest flag, eligibility, last PO rate and contract rate (the last two only for po.manage or contract.view).
Award RFQ lines to quote lines and create the draft POs in one transaction (all or nothing). Needs rfq.award, then po.manage.
notes: Second route guard: po.manage (403 PERMISSION_DENIED with key po.manage). rfq.award is checked first.

routes.summary: List sale orders, paginated (BR-SO-04). Filters `q` (SO no., customer PO no., customer name), `status` (CSV, unknown value 400), `customerId`, `orderDateFrom`, `orderDateTo`, `deliveryBefore`. `meta.statusCounts` ignores the `status` filter.
One sale order: header, lines, raisedDocuments (explosion-linked live PR / SCO), current snapshot summary (BR-SO-19, 51).
Create a draft SO with lines in one transaction (BR-SO-05..08, 56, 57). 400 inactive customer / item, bad qty / price / dates, same item + date twice; 409 CUSTOMER_PO_EXISTS.

Edit an SO: draft fully, confirmed limited; needs `editVersion` (BR-SO-09, 10, 13, 14, 59, 60). 409 STALE_VERSION / SO_NOT_EDITABLE / SO_FIELD_LOCKED / QTY_BELOW_DELIVERED / SO_LINE_DELIVERED / LIVE_DOCUMENTS_LINKED / CUSTOMER_PO_EXISTS.
Confirm a draft SO (BR-SO-12). 400 inactive customer / item or past delivery date; 409 wrong status / STALE_VERSION.
Hold a confirmed SO, reason 3-500 chars (BR-SO-16). 409 wrong status / STALE_VERSION.
Resume an on-hold SO to confirmed (BR-SO-16). 409 wrong status / STALE_VERSION.
Close a confirmed / on-hold SO by hand, reason 3-500 chars; releases reservations (BR-SO-17). 409 wrong status / STALE_VERSION.
Cancel an SO, reason 3-500 chars (BR-SO-18, 19, 20). 409 HAS_DELIVERIES / LIVE_DOCUMENTS_LINKED / wrong status / STALE_VERSION.
Audit trail of the SO: who, when, before -> after; paginated, newest first (BR-SO-52).
Run the BOM explosion of a confirmed SO: new numbered snapshot, older one superseded (BR-SO-21..38). 409 SO_NOT_CONFIRMED / EXPLOSION_IN_PROGRESS / EXPLOSION_BUSY; 400 EXPLOSION_TOO_LARGE.
List the snapshots of an SO, paginated (BR-SO-21).
Snapshot header, totals, `outOfDate` and reasons; 404 when the snapshot is not of this SO (BR-SO-38, 51). No prices.
Rows of a snapshot, paginated (BR-SO-50, 51). Filters `type`, `net=short`, `flagged`. Job-worker candidates only for `so.explode` holders. No prices.

Create draft PRs and SCOs from picked rows of the current snapshot, all or nothing (BR-SO-39..48). Also needs `pr.manage` / `sco.manage` per picked row (service check, 403). 409 SNAPSHOT_SUPERSEDED / SNAPSHOT_OUT_OF_DATE / ROW_ALREADY_RAISED / SO_NOT_CONFIRMED; 400 PICK_OVER_NET.
List subcontracting orders, paginated. Filters: `status` (comma list), `vendorId`, `q` (SCO number or vendor name).
Get a subcontracting order with its lines (item names, computed line value and GST, counters).
Create a draft subcontracting order with its lines in one call (BR-SCO-01..04). Line price/GST default to the vendor's service price list.
Edit a draft SCO (BR-SCO-05): header fields and/or replace all lines. Non-draft = 409; `status` in body = 400.
Submit a draft SCO for approval (BR-SCO-06); only its creator. Result is pending_approval, or approved when no chain applies.
Cancel an SCO (BR-SCO-20): draft/pending_approval/approved with nothing issued, else 409. Reason 3-500 chars always; the open approval request is cancelled too.
Issue material on an approved/material_issued SCO: creates a job-work challan JWC/<FY>/<seq> and posts store -> vendor location (BR-SCO-07..10). Path :id = SCO id.
List all challans of one SCO (newest first) with days left to the return due date (BR-SCO-11). Not paginated: an SCO has few challans.
Open challans (material not fully settled) across SCOs, paginated, with days left and dueStatus ok/warning/overdue (BR-SCO-11). Filters: vendorId, scoId, dueStatus.
Challan with lines plus print data: company settings, vendor (gstin null = unregistered), HSN per line, declaration text (BR-SCO-09, Rule 55).

Receive processed/unprocessed goods back on a material_issued SCO (BR-SCO-12, 16, 17). Needs vendorChallanNo (unique per vendor, 409). Unprocessed qty returns to store at save; processed qty waits for QA. Path :id = SCO id.
List all receipts of one SCO, newest first. Not paginated: an SCO has few receipts.
Receipt with its lines (QA state, decision actor/time) and the challan settlements (BR-SCO-17).
QA decision for one receipt line (BR-SCO-13..15): accepted + rejected = processed. Posts accepted to store and rejected to scrap yard. Second decision = 409.

Close a material_issued/material_received SCO (BR-SCO-19). Anything left at the vendor is written off as `sco_loss` and also needs `sco.loss_override` (403 otherwise) plus a reason 3-500 chars (400). Un-issued qty is dropped.
Stock at each vendor: per vendor and raw item, qty at the vendor location and value at issue cost. Filter: vendorId.
Loss log: one row per `sco_loss` write-off (SCO, item, qty, cost, close reason, who, when). Filters: vendorId, scoId, createdFrom, createdTo.
List all modules.
notes: Bounded reference data (all modules) — pagination intentionally omitted

routes.summary: List employees, paginated.
Debounced name-search over employees, paginated.
Create an employee (desk-worker password login or operator QR login).
Update an employee.
Soft-delete (deactivate) an employee.
notes: 409 LAST_ADMIN if it would leave no active super-admin (BR-AUTH-17). Logged.

routes.summary: Regenerate an operator's QR login token (returned once, raw).
List roles, paginated.
notes: S6: each row carries keyCount and employeeCount (active employees). Super-admin row: isSuperAdmin=true.

routes.summary: Create a role (no keys, isSystem=false).
notes: 409 CONFLICT on duplicate name. Logged (BR-AUTH-20).

routes.summary: Rename a role.
notes: 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED for any system role (BR-AUTH-18); 409 ROLE_IN_APPROVAL_CHAIN (BR-AUTH-19); 409 CONFLICT duplicate name. Logged.

routes.summary: Delete a role.
notes: 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED; 409 ROLE_HAS_EMPLOYEES (any active employee); 409 ROLE_HAS_INACTIVE_EMPLOYEES (only inactive employees hold it: move them to another role first); 409 ROLE_IN_APPROVAL_CHAIN (BR-AUTH-19). Logged.

routes.summary: Create a role as a copy of an existing role (same keys, BR-AUTH-25).
notes: 404 source role missing; 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED if source is super-admin; 409 CONFLICT duplicate name. Copy is never a system role. Logged.

routes.summary: Get a role's grants: the whole key catalog with a granted flag.
notes: Bounded reference data (permission catalog) — pagination intentionally omitted
Super-admin role: readOnly=true, every key granted:true (no list to edit, BR-AUTH-18). 404 unknown role.

routes.summary: Apply a grant diff (keys added / removed) to a role.
notes: 400 KEY_NOT_GRANTABLE for setup.roles.manage (BR-AUTH-07); 400 UNKNOWN_KEY for a key not in the catalog; 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED for the super-admin role; 404 unknown role. Whole diff is applied in one transaction or not at all. Actor/role cache cleared. Logged with before/after.

routes.summary: List screens with the roles that see each (BR-AUTH-15).
notes: Bounded reference data (screens come from code) — pagination intentionally omitted
Ordered by menuGroup, sortOrder, key.

routes.summary: Change a screen's label, order or menu group.
notes: 404 unknown screen key; 400 for any other field (path, permissionKey are code-owned). Logged with before/after.

routes.summary: Tick / untick roles on a screen = grant / revoke the screen's key.
notes: Same grant as POST /roles/:id/grants (also opens the API). 404 unknown screen or role; 400 SCREEN_HAS_NO_KEY when permissionKey is null; 400 KEY_NOT_GRANTABLE when the key is setup.roles.manage; 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED for the super-admin role. One transaction, logged per role.

routes.summary: Roles the caller may assign (BR-AUTH-16).
notes: Bounded reference data (roles) — pagination intentionally omitted
Super-admin: every role. Others: roles whose keys they all hold, never the super-admin role.

routes.summary: Assign an employee's one role (BR-AUTH-08, 16, 17).
notes: 400 if body has anything but a single roleId (e.g. roleIds[]); 404 unknown employee or role; 403 ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE when the caller (non-super-admin) lacks any key of the role or targets super-admin; 409 LAST_ADMIN when it would leave no active super-admin. Actor cache cleared for that employee. Logged.

routes.summary: Read-only access log, paginated (BR-AUTH-20).
notes: No write endpoints exist. Send sortBy=at&sortDir=desc for newest first.
Each row carries a one-line summary of the change, not the before/after records (BR-AUTH-31).

routes.summary: One access-log row with full before/after (BR-AUTH-31).
notes: 400 non-integer id; 404 unknown id. Read-only.

routes.summary: List suppliers, paginated. q matches name, contact, email, phone, GSTIN or item SKU; status filter all|active|inactive (default all); default sort name asc.
List a supplier's item catalog entries, paginated.
List a supplier's service catalog entries, paginated.
Get a supplier's master record plus item/service counts.
Create a supplier, optionally seeding its item catalog.
Add a single item catalog entry to a supplier.
Add a single service catalog entry to a supplier.
Update a supplier — discriminated by mode: master fields or a single supplier-item row.
Batch-edit one or more of a supplier's item catalog entries.
notes: response spreads service result fields directly ({success, data, summary}), not {success,data} — documented deviation, not normalized
max 100 rows; all rows save or none: any failed row -> 400 with body {success:false, message, code, data: rows[], summary} (rows carry success/error), nothing saved

routes.summary: Batch-edit one or more of a supplier's service catalog entries.
notes: response spreads service result fields directly ({success, data, summary}), not {success,data} — documented deviation, not normalized
max 100 rows; all rows save or none: any failed row -> 400 with body {success:false, message, code, data: rows[], summary} (rows carry success/error), nothing saved

routes.summary: A supplier's change history (master, item price rows, service price rows), newest first, paginated.
List supplier invoices, paginated. Filter by status (draft|blocked|payable|overdue|cancelled|all), supplierId, poId, grnId, q. meta adds statusCounts.
Billable GRN lines of a PO (optional grnId filter), prefilled at PO rate and GST. Only lines with billableQty > 0. 409 SINV_PO_NOT_BILLABLE when the PO status is not billable.
Supplier invoice details: header, lines, mismatches, history, document flow, linked debit notes, net payable, tolerances used.
Create a draft supplier invoice against a PO. Computed values (line taxable, tax heads, totals, tax type, due date) are server-set; extra body keys are 400.
Edit a draft supplier invoice (id in body, at least one other field; lines and charges replace the set; poId is immutable).
Delete a draft supplier invoice (hard delete, its history rows are kept). 409 SINV_NOT_DRAFT otherwise.
Submit a draft: run the 3-way match. Returns approved or blocked (a blocked bill is a 200 with mismatches). PO moves to invoiced when this bill covers it.
Send a blocked invoice back to draft for correction; the stored mismatches are cleared.
Release a blocked invoice to payable with a reason. 403 SINV_SELF_RELEASE if the caller created, edited, sent back or submitted it (super-admin included).
Cancel a blocked or approved invoice with a reason (3-500 chars blocked, 10-500 approved). Moves the PO invoiced -> fully_received when it was the covering invoice.
